description: Sample test created by import script. Replace fields before production use.

steps.action: Open the app and navigate to Dashboard.
Trigger Remote Config where ads_show_banner_main_screen=true.
steps.result:
- Banner is visible.
- Banner does not overlap primary CTA.
- Banner can be dismissed if design requires.

description: When testKey is provided, import writes steps into the existing Jira Test.

steps.action: Open Settings screen.
Toggle Auto Backup ON and return to previous screen.
steps.result:
- Auto Backup switch state is saved.
- No crash or freeze occurs.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify local backup is created when user is not logged in with Google
description: Verify that a local contacts backup can be created when the user is not logged in with a Google account.

steps.action: Open Contacts Backups while not logged in with a Google account.
Dismiss the Google Account Access popup by tapping Don't Connect, then create a backup.
steps.result:
- A local backup is created successfully.
- The backup appears in the Backups list.
- The user can use Backups without logging in with Google.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify cloud backup is created when user is logged in with Google
description: Verify that a cloud contacts backup can be created when the user is logged in with a Google account.

steps.action: Open Contacts Backups and log in with a Google account.
Create a contacts backup.
steps.result:
- A backup is created successfully.
- The backup appears in the Backups list.
- The backup is associated with the logged-in Google account.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify cloud backups are synced after logging in with Google
description: Verify that existing cloud backups are synced to the app after the user logs in with Google.

steps.action: Use a Google account that already has contacts backups stored in the cloud.
Log in with that Google account from the app and open Contacts Backups.
steps.result:
- Existing cloud backups are synced to the app.
- Synced backups appear in the Backups list.
- The user can open the synced backups.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify local backups are synced to cloud after logging in with Google
description: Verify that local backups created before Google login are synced to the cloud after the user logs in.

steps.action: Create a local contacts backup while not logged in with a Google account.
Log in with a Google account and open Contacts Backups.
steps.result:
- The existing local backup remains visible in the Backups list.
- The local backup is synced to the logged-in Google account.
- The backup remains available after reopening the Backups screen.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify user can log out from Google account in Settings
description: Verify that the user can disconnect the Google account from Settings and return to local backup mode.

steps.action: Log in with a Google account and confirm that Contacts Backups is connected.
Open Settings and log out or disconnect the Google account.
Open Contacts Backups after logging out from the Google account.
steps.result:
- The Google account is disconnected successfully.
- The app no longer shows the user as logged in with Google.
- The Backups screen is shown in the logged-out state.
- Future backup behavior returns to local backup mode.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify auto-backup is created after merging duplicate contacts when auto-backup is enabled
description: Verify that an automatic backup is created before or after merging duplicate contacts when auto-backup is enabled.

steps.action: Enable auto-backup in Contacts Backups.
Go to Duplicate contacts and merge duplicate contacts.
steps.result:
- The merge action is completed successfully.
- An automatic backup is created.
- The auto-backup appears in the Backups list.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify auto-backup is created after cleaning incomplete contacts when auto-backup is enabled
description: Verify that an automatic backup is created after cleaning incomplete contacts when auto-backup is enabled.

steps.action: Enable auto-backup in Contacts Backups.
Go to Incomplete contacts and clean selected contacts.
steps.result:
- The cleaning action is completed successfully.
- An automatic backup is created.
- The auto-backup appears in the Backups list.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify auto-backup is created after cleaning contacts from All Contacts when auto-backup is enabled
description: Verify that an automatic backup is created after cleaning contacts from All Contacts when auto-backup is enabled.

steps.action: Enable auto-backup in Contacts Backups.
Go to All Contacts and clean selected contacts.
steps.result:
- The cleaning action is completed successfully.
- An automatic backup is created.
- The auto-backup appears in the Backups list.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify no auto-backup is created after contact cleaning actions when auto-backup is disabled
description: Verify that no automatic backup is created after contact cleaning actions when auto-backup is disabled.

steps.action: Disable auto-backup in Contacts Backups.
Perform representative contact cleaning actions.
steps.data:
- Merge Duplicate contacts
- Clean Incomplete contacts
- Clean contacts from All Contacts
steps.result:
- The cleaning actions are completed successfully.
- No automatic backup is created.
- The Backups list does not show a new auto-backup generated by these actions.

summary: Contacts Backups > Verify Google Account Access popup behavior based on Google login status
description: Verify that the Google Account Access popup is shown when opening Backups without Google login and is no longer shown after logging in.

steps.action: Open Contacts Backups while not logged in with a Google account.
Observe the Google Account Access popup, then tap Don't Connect.
Log in with a Google account and open Contacts Backups again.
steps.result:
- The Google Account Access popup is shown when the user opens Backups without being logged in with Google.
- After tapping Don't Connect, the user can continue to Backups and use local backup.
- After logging in with Google, the Google Account Access popup is no longer shown when opening Backups.
